label: sec:archimedean-condition-leptons-preamble
html: Once the Descartes condition fixes the base genus at g = 4, the orientation strata of the Reeb flow on \Sigma_4 partition the simple closed curves into three charged lepton generations. This section derives the chirality involution distinguishing left- and right-handed sheets, parameterizes the affine light-cone coordinates, and anchors the chirality sign in the handedness of the trefoil knot 3_1.
